proposals.before: Zhang Cong also wrote "Questions on the Great Rites"; Huo Tao and Gui E, section directors, and Xiong Shi, supervising secretary, agreed with him.
proposals.after: Zhang Cong also wrote "Questions on the Great Rites"; Huo Tao and Gui E, section directors, and Xiong Jia, supervising secretary, agreed with him.
proposals.reason: 熊浹 is Xiong Jia (浹 jiā), not Xiong Shi.

proposals.before: Attendant Lü Zhen, supervising secretary Zeng Yan, censor Liu Xian, section director Yue Lun, and others then memorialized in turn.
proposals.after: Attendant Lü Nan, supervising secretary Zeng Ting, censor Liu Xian, section director Yue Lun, and others then memorialized in turn.
proposals.reason: 呂柟 is Lü Nan (柟 nán), not Zhen; 烶 is Ting.

proposals.before: At the same time Prince of Qin Fang took Wang Baobao's sister as consort and Deng Yu's daughter as a secondary match—precedents unknown in earlier ages.
proposals.after: At the same time Prince of Qin Shuang took Wang Baobao's sister as consort and Deng Yu's daughter as a secondary match—precedents unknown in earlier ages.
proposals.reason: 秦王樉 is Zhu Shuang (樉 shuǎng), not Fang.

decisions.reason: s0086 names 給事中熊浹; 浹 is Jia, so Xiong Shi is a wrong reading and Xiong Jia is the accurate replacement.
s0156 has 侍御呂柟 and 給事中曾烶; 柟 is Nan and 烶 is Ting, so Lü Zhen and Zeng Yan are misreadings and the proposed names restore the Chinese correctly.
s0193 names 秦王樉; 樉 is Shuang, so Prince of Qin Fang misreads the personal name and Shuang is the correct English form.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0002 shows English Zeng Yan came only from misreading 烶; the personal-name claim must read Zeng Ting while keeping zh, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
